launch_condition: both S_OP7 (3900007) and S_OP8 (3900008) have reached their frozen 1,000,000-step checkpoints AND the GPU is free. Do not run concurrently with training.
run_order: specialist 5-policy cross-eval first, then this replication, then read both together

why_this_is_separate_from_the_specialist.specialist_pilot_asks: can direct OP7/OP8 training deliberately CREATE complementary best responses?
why_this_is_separate_from_the_specialist.this_protocol_asks: does the ORIGINAL D1-3600001 <-> D7-3200001 crossover reproduce on unseen episodes at all?
why_this_is_separate_from_the_specialist.independence: the two questions are answered by different policies on different episodes; neither result determines the other

the_circularity_this_removes.problem: D1-3600001 and D7-3200001 are the exact pair that PRODUCED the PATH_B verdict. Two of the three detected crossovers are that pair, selected by scanning ~1176 two-way tests. Recomputing anything on the same 30-episode cells reuses the data that selected them, so the crossover is guaranteed to reappear.
the_circularity_this_removes.fix: a disjoint episode-seed block. Same policies, same opponents, same environment, genuinely new episodes.
the_circularity_this_removes.preregistered_by: PAPER_PATH_READOUT_FROZEN.json multiplicity_caveat, which names 'targeted confirmatory evaluation' alongside the specialist pilot as the confirmation branch

episode_seeds.discovery_block_use: NOT USED by this protocol. It is the block that produced the discovery.
episode_seeds.paired: both policies see the identical seed block per opponent, as in run_g0_v2_evaluation

primary_gate.name: OP7_OP8_CROSSOVER_REPLICATES
primary_gate.estimator: two-proportion Wald 95% CI on the difference, n=60 per cell
primary_gate.why_this_axis: OP7/OP8 is the selected axis and the one the specialist pilot targets

secondary_not_required.OP11_crossover: the discovery also recorded a D7-3200001 vs D1-3600001 crossover on OP7/OP11 with LCB95 = .0333. It is REPORTED but NOT required to replicate. It was the thinnest of the three and is not the selected axis.
secondary_not_required.rule: failure of the OP11 pair does not fail this protocol; success of it does not rescue a failed OP7/OP8 gate

repertoire_value_is_a_separate_claim.warning: a replicated crossover establishes complementary matchup strengths. It does NOT establish that selecting between the two policies beats committing to one.

required_before_any_repertoire_claim.V_fixed_comparator: max over the FULL 5-policy set (S_OP7, S_OP8, D1-3600001, D3-3700001, D7-3200001), not max over the pair
required_before_any_repertoire_claim.reason: either policy may be better than the other overall across the seven-opponent board, in which case routing adds nothing even with a real crossover

status_vocabulary.CROSSOVER_REPLICATES (this protocol's ga: A and B are CANDIDATE teachers. Nothing stronger.
status_vocabulary.delta_pool >= 0.05 AND LCB95 > 0 (the ga: A and B become CONFIRMED teachers, eligible for K=2 birth.
status_vocabulary.rule: never write 'D1/D7 are the teachers' on the strength of this protocol's gate alone -- write 'candidate teachers' until the repertoire-value gate is separately scored.

claim_hierarchy.2_REPERTOIRE_VALUE: choosing among those strengths is actually useful
claim_hierarchy.3_LATENT_COMPRESSION: one network can preserve that useful repertoire
claim_hierarchy.rule: three different claims, three different gates. Passing 1 never implies 2, and passing 2 never implies 3.

diagnostic_grid.note: the value of running both experiments is that the PAIR of outcomes identifies the phenomenon, not just whether a gate passed
diagnostic_grid.specialists_PASS__pair_REPLICATES: strongest result: a reproducible strategic axis that deliberate specialization can also recreate
diagnostic_grid.specialists_FAIL__pair_REPLICATES: useful policy regimes exist but direct opponent specialization does not recreate them. The teacher-compression route (D1-3600001 / D7-3200001 as K=2 teachers) becomes the attractive path, still gated on repertoire value.
diagnostic_grid.specialists_PASS__pair_DOES_NOT_REPLICAT: original PATH_B was likely a selection/multiplicity artifact, but direct specialization independently created a repertoire. Follow the specialist evidence, not the discovery pair.
diagnostic_grid.specialists_FAIL__pair_DOES_NOT_REPLICAT: PATH_B did not survive confirmation and specialists did not recreate it. Stop the escalation and report the diversity-scaling result.

implementation_prerequisite.blocker: experiments/run_crossplay_eval.py line 97 hardcodes seed = E.EVAL_SEED_BASE + i. There is no --seed-base flag, so the confirmation block cannot be requested.
implementation_prerequisite.required_change: add an additive --seed-base argument defaulting to E.EVAL_SEED_BASE, so the default code path stays byte-identical to the one that produced the 56-cell matrix
implementation_prerequisite.compatibility_requirement: the default path must be verified unchanged before this protocol runs; the evaluator is shared with the specialist cross-eval
implementation_prerequisite.prohibited: changing EVAL_SEED_BASE itself, which would silently move every future evaluation off the block the completed matrix used

prohibited: running this concurrently with S_OP7/S_OP8 training
reusing the discovery block 9100000-9100029 for any cell here
selecting a different policy pair after seeing these results
reporting a replicated crossover as repertoire value
